newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson-CSF sells Cr Lyonnais stake.
newsitem.headline: Thomson-CSF sells Cr Lyonnais stake.

text.p: Thomson-CSF said in a statement that it had agreed on December 23 to sell its stake in bank Credit Lyonnais of 9,320,264 shares to the state for 2.3 billion francs.
It said it would receive the money within two months after the agreement and after consultation between France and the European Commission.

The price of the transaction had been established after an evaluation by Deutsche Morgan Grenfell. The shares were valued at 2.859 billion francs after which 515 million was deducted for some property assets.
Thomson-CSF made the statement following news paper articles about the deal.
